Warm lavender steam billows from the pipe, soothing the rattling carriage as it glides to a stop and the doors part at the Depot.

Inside lies a glowing glass tube shaped like an ampersand, which you carefully pocket right as the truck halts inside the glowing workshop and the doors clunk open.

a bulging leather tool pouch resting centre between your knees
the leather-jacketed driver on the right gripping vibrating chrome handlebars

You tap the driver's shoulder, and they nod toward flickering neon signs. The motor purrs to a stop at Midnight Radio Repair, its door unlatching.

shown: a brass clockwork conductor holding out glowing starry tokens on the left
a bulging leather satchel strapped shut beneath an empty bench in centre
a wide arched observation window framing distant city roofs on the right
beats: The warm star token chimes happily in your palm, unlocking the upper hatch just as the funicular docks and its doors glide open.
You tuck away the comet charts found inside the satchel right as the carriage reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and slides open.
Your telescope catches the comet's greenish glow through the glass, just before the funicular halts smoothly and the doors part wide.

A soft chime rings out, dropping a tiny commemorative gear into your palm. The crawler jolts to a gentle stop as the doors open onto Gear Bridge.

a sloshing metal pail glowing with strange luminescent green water on the right

The operator coos cheerfully and presses a damp umbrella token into your hand. The cables lock, and the exit doors slide open.
A tiny clockwork frog springs from the glowing green suds straight into your pocket! The gondola jolts to a halt, opening its doors to the mist.

He shares clever tricks for dodging turning gears, handing you a wrench ticket as the brakes hiss and the platform doors rumble open.

after.label: Stay on

The bell chimes overhead, dusting your beanie in colourful confetti. With a merry jingle, the train halts at Lost Property Depot and the doors part before you.
